My book on QTL mapping and R/qtl (written with Saunak Sen) is now
available:

Broman KW, Sen S (2009) A Guide to QTL Mapping with R/qtl.
Springer, New York (ISBN: 978-0-387-92124-2)

Buy it at Amazon, http://www.amazon.com/exec/obidos/ASIN/0387921249/7210-20
or directly from Springer, http://www.springer.com/978-0-387-92124-2

The online complements include a sample chapter and all of the code;
see http://www.rqtl.org/book
